title: Plunging test scores are a slow-moving catastrophe
summary: This Hacker News discussion centers on declining standardized test scores framed as a slow-moving catastrophe, with 369 comments debating causes such as pandemic disruptions, curriculum changes, and grading standards. The linked article is paywalled via archive.ph. Despite the AI/ML framing, the content is primarily education policy and social commentary, with little direct technical AI/ML substance.
